custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 3 on hand, on no return.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425717 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425717 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425717-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 3. Click Save.
